metadata.title: Identity Assurance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Institutional capability governing confidence and assurance in identity assertions.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Identity assurance, risk evaluation, and confidence signaling services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Adaptive identity assurance with dynamic evaluation and assurance propagation.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Digital Identity subject to assurance evaluation.

metadata.remarks:
Identity Assurance defines the capability to evaluate, express, and propagate confidence in identity assertions based on authentication strength, contextual risk, and observed behavior. Assurance enables adaptive access decisions and consistent trust signaling across systems.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, and assurance related to identity confidence and assurance. Identity semantics are defined by Identity Core; assurance governs confidence and reliability.

components.title: Assurance Levels
components.description: Definition and classification of assurance levels representing confidence in identity assertions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation of authentication or trust processes to reduce effective assurance.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit definition and enforcement of assurance levels.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Define and apply strength-of-mechanism and assurance requirements.

components.title: Confidence Signals
components.description: Collection and evaluation of signals contributing to identity confidence, including authentication method, device posture, and behavior.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Spoofing or manipulation of signals used to determine identity confidence.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Evaluation of behavioral and contextual confidence signals.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Monitor signals relevant to identity confidence and risk.

components.title: Risk Context
components.description: Incorporation of contextual and situational risk into identity assurance evaluations.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid identities under elevated risk conditions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Adjustment of assurance based on contextual risk.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Assess risk associated with identity use.
Adapt assurance requirements based on assessed risk.

components.title: Assurance Propagation
components.description: Propagation of identity assurance claims and confidence levels to relying systems and services.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Cryptographically and logically protected propagation of assurance signals.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Ensure assurance claims are correctly conveyed.
Log assurance evaluation and propagation events.
